description.zh: 创建频道的时间戳，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
description.en: Timestamp of channel creation. Supports querying data from the last 30 days. Represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

description.zh:
频道释放时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
> 如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据。
description.en:
Channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If the parameter is empty, the current time is used.  
> If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the creation time to the actual release time will be returned.

description.zh: 父级地区名称，例如：深圳市的父级为广东省。参数为空表示世界范围（国家维度）的统计，例如：中国、英国。
description.en: Parent region name. For example, the parent of Shenzhen City is Guangdong Province. If the parameter is empty, statistics are returned at the global level (country dimension), such as China or the United Kingdom.

title.zh: 获取频道地区分布统计数据

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于获取频道地区分布统计数据。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to obtain the statistics on the regional distribution of channels.  
### queries per second (QPS) limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second (QPS) per User. If the limit is exceeded, Rate Limiting will be applied to your API Calls, which may Impact your business. Invoke this API appropriately.
